title: 2023 AMC 8 Problem 25
statement:
Fifteen integers \(a_1,\) \(a_2,\) \(a_3,\) \(\cdots,\) \(a_{15}\) are arranged in order on a number line. The integers are equally spaced and have the property that

\[ 1 \leq a_1 \leq 10, \]

\[ 13 \leq a_2 \leq 20, \]

and

\[ 241 \leq a_{15} \leq 250. \]

What is the sum of the digits of \(a_{14}?\)

solutions.text:
Let \(d\) be the common difference. Using the largest possible value \(10\) for \(a_1\) and the smallest possible value \(241\) for \(a_{15},\) we have \[ d \geq \dfrac{241 - 10}{14} = 16.5. \] Since all the numbers are integers, \(d\) must be at least \(17.\)

Using the smallest possible value \(1\) for \(a_1\) and the largest possible value \(250\) for \(a_{15},\) we have \[ d \leq \dfrac{250 - 1}{14} \approx 17.8. \] Since all the numbers are integers, \(d\) is at most \(17.\) Therefore, \(d=17.\)

Note that \(17 \cdot 14 = 238.\) Since \(a_{15}\) is at least \(241,\) \(a_1\) must be at least \(3.\)

On the other hand, if \(a_1\) were greater than \(3,\) then \(a_2=a_1+17\) would be greater than \(20,\) which is not allowed.

Now we know that \(a_1 = 3\) and \(d = 17.\) This tells us that \[ a_{14} = 3 + 13 \cdot 17 = 224. \]

Therefore, sum of the digits is \[2 + 2 + 4 = 8.\]

Thus, A is the correct answer.
hints: Use the widest possible bounds for \(a_1\) and \(a_{15}\) to force \(d\)
